description: Withheld-response vectors (SPEC §7.2 item 11, Disposition of a duplicate). Each case consumes its `deliveries` in order against one fresh replay guard, under the consequential checks at `now`, passing each document as received. The handler answers every delivery it is called for with a success response whose `id` is `resp-<n>` (n: the delivery's index in the case) and whose payload is {"delivery": "first"} or {"delivery": "redelivery"}, as the pipeline's delivery signal says; when the case has `withhold: true` it asks for its response to be kept out of the record on every call. Per delivery, `handler` is the signal the handler was called with (`first` or `redelivery`), or null when it was not called; `outcome` is `handled`, `duplicate`, or the refusal's error code; `priorResponseOf` is, for a duplicate, the index of the delivery whose response it replays.

cases.name: withheld response: a duplicate is handed to the handler as a re-delivery
cases.why: The first delivery executes and its response is not stored; the id stays claimed, so every duplicate reaches the handler only as a re-delivery (never as a first execution, and withholding on a re-delivery changes nothing), and a different document under the id is still idConflict.

cases.name: response recorded (the default): a duplicate replays it
cases.why: A handler that does not opt out sees no change: the duplicate is absorbed and answered with the stored first response, and the handler is not called.
